product.description: Peredonov este profesor într-un orășel de provincie din Rusia țaristă. Lipsit de calități morale și de merite intelectuale, în timp ce este vânat de familiile care au fete de măritat, Peredonov își stabilește obiectivul absurd de a fi numit inspector. Mașinațiile nu mai puțin imoralei sale concubine sunt menite să-i dea de înțeles că doar căsătoria cu ea ar putea să-i asigure aspirantului accesul la funcția râvnită. Mizantrop și oportunist, narcisist și corupt, antieroul romanului devine paranoic până la delir și până la crimă. Alături de personajul principal, evoluează o varietate de figuri tipice din societatea măruntă a vremii, îmbogățite, însă, cu caracteristici inedite care dau fiecăreia individualitate. Demonul meschin a fost perceput ca un rechizitoriu al societății ruse a vremii, o combinație între tendințele simboliste și tradiția marelui realism rus.   O conștiință torturată de „blestematele probleme“ ale vieții, aspirând spre perfecțiune și veșnic dezamăgită de imperfecțiunea naturii umane, sfâșiată de propriile sale antinomii, ca și de vulgaritatea mediului înconjurător. Acesta este portretul spiritual al lui Feodor Sologub – o conștiință tragică a literaturii ruse, așa cum ne apare în capodopera sa, Demonul meschin. Tamara Gane

# Demonul Meschin by Tamara Gane: A Journey into Tsarist Russian Psychology

Immerse yourself in a masterpiece of classic Russian literature with *Demonul meschin*. ## The Wretched Demon: Plot and Themes

The narrative centers on Peredonov, a professor residing in a provincial Russian town during the Tsarist era. Initially lacking both moral character and intellectual merit, Peredonov finds himself constantly entangled with powerful families who are determined to marry off their daughtersâa backdrop against which he attempts to establish himself as an inspector.

As his ambitious machinations escalate, he relies on concubines whose equally immoral schemes convince him that marriage to one of them is the only path to achieving his desired official status. Peredonov is a deeply flawed character: cynical, opportunistic, narcissistic, and corrupt. His downward spiral takes him from social climber to a paranoid state bordering on delirium, ultimately leading to crime.

The novel does more than just follow its protagonist. It chronicles the evolution of various figures typical of the period's petite societyâthe wealthy, the ambitious, and the marginalized. Each character is given unique characteristics that enrich the overall portrait of Russian life during this era.

### A Literary Portrait of an Era

*Demonul meschin* has been widely regarded as a social mirror reflecting 19th-century Russian society. The novel masterfully blends Symbolist tendencies with the traditions of great Russian realism, creating a rich tapestry of human experience.

The work delves into the tormented consciousnessâa mind struggling with the "curse of life's problems." It is a yearning for perfection that remains perpetually disappointed by the imperfections inherent in human nature, and simultaneously ripped apart by internal contradictions and the vulgarity of its surroundings. For scholars of Russian literature, this novel stands as a tragic spiritual portrait of the period.

***

## Understanding the Novel

**What kind of book is *Demonul meschin*?**
It is a deeply psychological literary novel set in Tsarist Russia, focusing on themes of ambition, moral corruption, social class, and personal decay. It is considered essential reading for fans of classic Russian literature.

**Who is the author?**
The story is based on the work of Fyodor Sologub', making it a foundational piece of early 20th-century Russian literary fiction. This edition is presented by Tamara Gane.
